story_text: As a user, I want the system to handle an email with special characters correctly during registration so that valid edge-case emails are accepted.

positive.title: Register successfully with email containing valid special characters
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter a valid email address with special characters (e.g., john.doe+newsletter@example.com).
3. Fill in the other required registration fields.
positive.expected_result: The system should accept the email and complete the registration process successfully.

positive.title: Register successfully with email containing subdomain and special characters
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter a valid email address with a subdomain and special characters (e.g., john.doe+newsletter@sub.example.com).
3. Fill in the other required registration fields.
positive.expected_result: The system should accept the email and complete the registration process successfully.

negative.title: Reject email with invalid format
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter an invalid email address with special characters (e.g., john..doe@example..com).
3. Fill in the other required registration fields.
negative.expected_result: The system should reject the email and display an error message.

negative.title: Reject email with unsupported special characters
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter an email address with unsupported special characters (e.g., john$doe@example.com).
3. Fill in the other required registration fields.
negative.expected_result: The system should reject the email and display an error message.

negative.title: Reject email with misplaced special characters (e.g., starting/ending with dot)
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter an email address with misplaced special characters (e.g., .john.doe@example.com).
3. Fill in the other required registration fields.
negative.expected_result: The system should reject the email and display an error message.

edge.title: Register with email containing special characters at boundary positions
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter a valid email address with special characters at boundary positions (e.g., .john.doe.@example.com).
3. Fill in the other required registration fields.
edge.expected_result: The system should accept the email and complete the registration process successfully.

edge.title: Register with email containing uppercase and special characters combination
steps: 1. Navigate to the registration page.
2. Enter a valid email address with uppercase and special characters (e.g., JOHN.DOE+NEWSLETTER@EXAMPLE.COM).
3. Fill in the other required registration fields.
edge.expected_result: The system should accept the email and complete the registration process successfully.
